newsitem.title: FINLAND: NORVESTIA SAYS STRONGBOX STAKE OVER 21 PCT.
newsitem.headline: NORVESTIA SAYS STRONGBOX STAKE OVER 21 PCT.

text.p: Finnish investment company Norvestia Oy Ab said on Friday that Strongbox Oy had upped its holding in Norvestia to 21.02 percent.
"Strongbox Oy ... has informed the company that its stake in Norvestia Oy Ab's share capital has on June 5, 1996, risen above one-fifth," Norvestia said in a statement.
Strongbox Oy is a wholly owned subsidiary of Swedish group Strongbox Holdings AB, Norvestia said.
Strongbox now owns 300,000 series A shares (5.73 percent) and 800,000 series B shares (15.29 percent), Norvestia said.
Norvestia did not say what Strongbox's stake previously had been, nor did it identify the seller of the shares.
